title: Tinyland v4 Bazel action plan
description: Normative executable Bazel action plan for the v4 ci-templates workflow. Attachment authority lives only in tinyland.repo.json; this document contains no runner, substrate mode, endpoint, credential, tenant, repository identity, lifecycle, publication, or apply authority.

schema_version.description: Breaking v4 plan interface. Version 2 removes every attachment and lifecycle field from lanes.json.

actions.description: Bazel actions keyed by their log and evidence identity. JSON object keys make action names unique by construction; the v4 workflow executes every entry exactly once through gloriousflywheel-bazel.

command.description: Bazel command passed verbatim to gloriousflywheel-bazel.

targets.description: Finite workspace-local Bazel labels passed verbatim to gloriousflywheel-bazel. Flags and external-repository labels are not accepted.
